neighbours.label: the token ' phot' / 'Phot' (the photo- prefix split off, as in photovoltaic, photoreceptor, phototherapy)
fire: In the retina, each photoreceptor responds to a narrow band of light.
The office finally replaced its old photocopier last month.
Modern chips are patterned using photolithography on silicon wafers.
For newborn jaundice, doctors often prescribe phototherapy.
Her friends joke that the dog is far more photogenic than she is.
Astronomers use photometry to measure how bright a star is.
The farm sells power from its photovoltaic panels to the grid.
After the treatment, his skin stayed photosensitive for weeks.
quiet: In the retina, each nerve cell responds to a narrow band of light.
The office finally replaced its old printer last month.
Modern chips are patterned using lasers on silicon wafers.
For newborn jaundice, doctors often prescribe a photochemical lamp.
Her friends joke that the dog is a far better photographer than she is.
Astronomers use a camera to measure how bright a star is.
The farm sells power from its photoelectric cells to the grid.
After the treatment, his skin stayed red in photographs for weeks.

notes: Probe: ' phot'/'Phot' 0.72-0.88 in photovoltaic, photodynamic, photobooth, photodetector and Photobacterium. ' photon' 0.26, ' photos|ynthesis' 0.23, ' photo' 0.07, 'solar power' 0.004. The near misses use whole photo-words tokenized as ' photo', ' photographer' etc. (tokenizer checked).
